name: Subway Station Greenery: Preference, Restoration and Space Image
description: Method replication with the paper's own model images (the original showed walk-through videos of the same 3D models): participants give gender and age group, then walk through eight versions of a subway station interior in random order (underground and ground-level station, each with a greenness index of 0, 10, 15 or 20 %), seeing four views of each (entrance, square, passage, fare gates; 4 s each). After each version they rate preference (1-5), how large the planted area looks (planted versions only), the seven recovery-scale items (coming to rest, renew energy, become myself again, lose all tension, order my thoughts again, put everything behind me, regain the ability to concentrate; 1-5) and six semantic-differential pairs (dark-bright, uncomfortable-comfortable, not beautiful-beautiful, unpleasant-pleasant, unharmonious-harmonious, not environmentally friendly-environmentally friendly). Rebuilt from Kim & Lee (2021), Sensors 21(13): 4360, with the 32 model images printed in the paper's Table 1 and the items and answer labels in its Section 2.2.2 (CC BY 4.0). Analysis as in the paper: one-way ANOVA with Games-Howell post-hoc tests across the four greenness levels, separately for underground and ground stations; mean of the seven recovery items as the attention restoration score; correspondence analysis of the recoded positive responses. Differences from the original study: (1) the original showed videos of the 3D models; here the four still views from the paper's Table 1 (221 x 124 px) are shown one after another; (2) no EEG (the paper measured prefrontal alpha and high-beta asymmetry); (3) the sentence stem 'Being in this station would help me ...' and the age-group options are our wording; (4) the eight models appear in random order.
author: Kim & Lee

elements.name: consent
elements.title: I agree to take part. Participation is voluntary and my answers are recorded anonymously for research.

elements.name: age_group
elements.title: Age group
elements.description: Our wording; the paper's sample was 30 people in their 20s and 30 in their 30s.

elements.name: preference
elements.title: How much do you prefer this station interior?
elements.description: Model preference, 5 points as in the paper. Keyed by station model: underground_gi00/gi10/gi15/gi20 and ground_gi00/gi10/gi15/gi20 (greenness index 0, 10, 15, 20 %), each shown as four views (entrance, square, passage, fare gates) from the paper's Table 1.

elements.name: planting_area
elements.title: How large does the planted area look to you?
elements.description: Level of recognition of the interior landscape area: 1 too low, 2 low, 3 suitable, 4 high, 5 very high. Asked only for models with planting (GI 10-20 %), as in the paper. Keyed by station model: underground_gi00/gi10/gi15/gi20 and ground_gi00/gi10/gi15/gi20 (greenness index 0, 10, 15, 20 %), each shown as four views (entrance, square, passage, fare gates) from the paper's Table 1.
